schedules.name: Daily Autonomous Marketing & Multi-Channel Content Engine
schedules.description: Native AVENIQ AI autonomous workflow running daily at 09:00 AM IST. Executes Trend Research -> Competitor Intel -> SEO -> Content Planner -> Blog (1200-1800 words) -> LinkedIn -> Instagram -> Facebook -> X -> Hashtags -> CTA -> AI Hero Image -> 5-Slide Carousel -> Quality Checker (Score >= 90) -> Supabase Storage -> Telegram Bot Notification.
schedules.prompt:
[AUTONOMOUS WORKFLOW SPECIFICATION]
Goal: Autonomous Daily Growth & Multi-Channel Content Operations Engine
Schedule: Daily @ 09:00 AM IST (Cron: 0 9 * * *, Timezone: Asia/Kolkata)

[EXECUTION DAG & AGENT NODE GRAPH]

Node 1: Trend Research Agent
- Data Collectors: Google Trends, Reddit (r/artificial, r/SaaS), LinkedIn Trending, X (Tech Trends), Hacker News Top, AI News RSS, Competitor Websites
- Primary Outputs: trends_matrix, primary_keywords, market_opportunities, buyer_intent_signals

Node 2: Competitor Intelligence Agent
- Data Analyzers: Competitor positioning matrix, top performing post formats, messaging white-space
- Primary Outputs: competitor_posts, engagement_ideas, content_gaps, positioning_angles

Node 3: SEO & Keyword Research Agent
- Data Analyzers: Search intent, keyword clustering, search volume estimates, FAQ extractors
- Primary Outputs: primary_keywords, secondary_keywords, target_h1_title, meta_description, faqs_list, internal_linking_ideas

Node 4: Content Planner Agent
- Action: Map trends + competitor gaps + SEO intent into cohesive multi-platform content roadmap
- Primary Outputs: content_calendar_entry, theme_summary, target_audience_segment

Node 5: Blog Writer Agent
- Specifications: 1200-1800 words, SEO optimized (1.5-2.5% keyword density), H2/H3 structure, introduction hook, value body, embedded citations, conclusion CTA
- Primary Outputs: full_blog_article, blog_excerpt, reading_time_minutes

Node 6: LinkedIn Writer Agent
- Specifications: Thought-leadership post, strong 1-line hook, bulleted value insights, industry tone, discussion question & CTA
- Primary Outputs: linkedin_post_text

Node 7: Instagram Writer Agent
- Specifications: Engaging visual caption, line-break formatting, carousel slide callouts, story highlight prompt & CTA
- Primary Outputs: instagram_caption_text

Node 8: Facebook Writer Agent
- Specifications: Community-oriented long-form post, engagement question, link preview snippet & CTA
- Primary Outputs: facebook_post_text

Node 9: X (Twitter) Writer Agent
- Specifications: 5-tweet thread format + 1 punchy stand-alone tweet, character count compliance (<= 280 chars/tweet)
- Primary Outputs: x_thread_tweets, x_single_tweet

Node 10: Hashtag Generator
- Action: Generate categorized hashtags (niche, industry, high-volume, brand)
- Primary Outputs: hashtags_list (#AI, #SaaS, #Automation, #AVENIQ, #TechTrends)

Node 11: CTA Generator
- Action: Synthesize high-converting calls-to-action tailored per channel
- Primary Outputs: primary_cta, secondary_cta, channel_ctas

Node 12: Image Generator
- Action: Synthesize AI prompts & generate visual assets via Google Imagen 3 / Pollinations AI
- Primary Outputs: hero_image_url, instagram_image_url, linkedin_header_url

Node 13: Carousel Generator
- Action: Design 5-slide visual carousel layout (Slide 1: Hook, Slide 2-4: Core Value Points, Slide 5: CTA & Summary)
- Primary Outputs: carousel_slides_array, carousel_pdf_url

Node 14: Quality Checker Agent
- Evaluation Criteria: Grammar, SEO score, Citation validity, Duplicate content check, Brand voice compliance, Readability index
- Strict Threshold: Minimum Quality Score >= 90/100; trigger auto-retry pipeline if score < 90
- Primary Outputs: quality_score, audit_report, pass_fail_status

Node 15: Supabase Persistence Engine
- Database Target: PostgreSQL / Supabase storage tables
- Records Persisted: research_data, blog_article, social_posts, captions, hashtags, cta, image_urls, carousel_data, quality_report, execution_metadata
- Primary Outputs: supabase_record_id, db_status

Node 16: Telegram Bot Dispatcher
- Telegram Notification Payload:
  • Executive Summary & Topic
  • Quality Score & Audit Result
  • SEO Blog Article & Title
  • LinkedIn Post Copy
  • Instagram Caption Copy
  • Facebook Post Copy
  • X (Twitter) Thread & Tweet
  • Hashtags & CTAs
  • AI Hero Image URL & Preview
  • 5-Slide Carousel Summary & URL
  • Supabase Record ID & Execution Timestamps

Node 17: Execution Timeline & Audit Logger
- Action: Record execution timeline event, update schedule statistics, transition session state
